eyebrow.zh: 行级归属 · 人类/代理分清 · 未审阅即提醒
eyebrow.en: line-level authorship · human vs agent · flags unreviewed

headline.zh: git blame 看不出哪行是 AI 写的，provmark 标得清
headline.en: git blame can't tell which lines your AI wrote, provmark can

sub.zh: 读取代理会话日志，把每处改动对齐到 git diff，标出人类还是代理，归属随提交一起留下。
sub.en: It reads the agent's session log, aligns each edit to the git diff, marks it human or agent, and persists that attribution with the commit.

title.zh: 人和代理的改动分得开

body.zh: 代理和你一起改了代码，git blame 却把你们压成同一个提交者。provmark 把每处改动盖成人类或代理，归属随提交一起留下——换机器、换会话都不丢。
body.en: An agent edited alongside you, and git blame collapses you into one committer. provmark stamps every edit human or agent and keeps that split with the commit — across machines, sessions, and clones.

body.zh: git blame 把整段提交都报成你。provmark blame 在它旁边逐行标出人类还是代理——代理写的那几行一下就亮出来。
body.en: git blame reports the whole commit as you. provmark blame marks human or agent per line right beside it — the lines the agent wrote light up at once.

title.en: No agent edit slips past unreviewed

body.zh: 代理写的行混进提交，没人提醒就容易漏审。provmark review 列出未审阅的代理改动并定位到具体范围——只提醒，绝不阻断你的提交。
body.en: Agent-written lines slip into commits and, without a nudge, go unreviewed. provmark review lists unreviewed agent changes and points to the exact ranges — it only warns, never blocks your commit.

tag.zh: git blame 给提交者，provmark 给编辑级归属。
tag.en: git blame gives the committer; provmark gives edit-level authorship.
